newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude brings dual chamber pacemaker to market.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude brings dual chamber pacemaker to market.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said Tuesday its META DDDR 1256 dual-chamber rate-responsive pacemaker is available for sale.
The launch of the device follows approval by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for St. Jude's Telectronics unit to make the META DDDR 1256 at its Miami Lakes, Fla., facility.

The pacemaker monitors a patient's heartbeat and automatically adjusts pacing rates to physical and emotional condition. A DDDR pacemaker is designed to allow the heart to beat at faster rates during periods of exertion.
St. Jude Medical completed the purchase of Telectronics on November 29. It said it is in the process of integrating Telectronics into its cardiac rhythm management business.
The META DDDR 1256 will be distributed by the Telectronics sales force. The device has been available outside the U.S. since October 1995.

As previously announced, St. Jude Medical is pursuing U.S. government and shareholder approval to merge with Ventritex Inc , a manufacturer of implantable cardioverter defibrillator systems. The merger is expected to close in the first quarter of 1997.
St. Jude Medical makes and distributes medical devices.
